# cadvilla

> > cadvilla is a professional 2D/3D CAD software for architectural design, house planning, and interior visualization available in multiple languages and editions.

cadvilla provides comprehensive architecture and home design software with multiple product editions (Basic, Basic Plus, Professional, Professional Plus) tailored to different user needs. The platform supports floor plan design, 3D visualization, and includes extensive object libraries for furniture, kitchens, and interior elements.

## Key Topics

- 3D CAD Software
- Architectural Planning
- House Planning (Hausplanung)
- Floor Plan Design
- 3D Visualization
- Interior Design
- cadvilla Basic
- cadvilla Professional
- Windows Software
- Home Design Tools
- Product Editions
- Object Libraries
- Raytracing
- CAD Architecture
- Visualization Services

## Product Editions

- [cadvilla basic](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/cadvilla_basic): Entry-level architecture software edition for basic 2D/3D home planning
- [cadvilla basic plus](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/cadvilla_basic_plus): Mid-tier edition with raytracing and advanced visualization features
- [cadvilla professional](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/cadvilla_pro): Advanced 3D architecture software for professional-level design work
- [cadvilla professional plus](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/cadvilla_pro_plus): Premium edition with electrical planning and interior design capabilities
- [Version Comparison](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/versionsvergleich_js): Detailed feature comparison across cadvilla versions with feature coverage
- [Features Comparison Table](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/funktionen-im-vergleich): Tabular comparison of edition features and capabilities

## Core Features & Functionality

- [Core Features Overview](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/grundfunktionen): Essential features and properties of cadvilla CAD software for 2D/3D planning
- [3D Object Libraries](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/z-objekte): Comprehensive collections of 3D objects including furniture, kitchens, and vehicles
- [Window Construction Module](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/z-diverse): Addon module for creating custom window profiles and constructions

## Getting Started & Guides

- [House Planning Guide](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/haus-planen): Beginner's guide to house planning with tips on forms, sizing, and software usage
- [House Building Checklist](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/hausbau-planen): Comprehensive checklist for house building from site selection to financing

## Professional Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/dienstleistungen): Professional services including virtual tours, 3D rendering, and visualizations
- [Plan Capture Service](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/sv-planerfassung): Digitization service for converting architectural projects to digital plans
- [Real Estate Floor Plans](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/sv-exposeplan): Professional floor plan digitization and drawing service for real estate
- [Manufacturer Integration](https://www.cadvilla.com/de/sv-hersteller): Program for manufacturers to add custom products to cadvilla catalog
